name: HondaJet
summary: Very light jet built in Greensboro, North Carolina; its engines are mounted on pylons above the wings rather than on the fuselage.

wings: Engine pylons rising from the top of each wing
engines: Two GE Honda HF120 turbofans mounted on pylons over the wings (over-the-wing engine mounts)
fuselage: Curvy natural-laminar-flow nose with a distinctive bulbous profile
Clean rear fuselage with no engines attached

tellTales: Engines perched on pylons on top of the wings
Clean rear fuselage with nothing mounted on it

confusedWith.howToTell: The HondaJet's engines sit above the wings; the Phenom 100's engines are on the rear fuselage.
The HondaJet's engines sit above the wings; the Mustang's engines are on the rear fuselage and its tailplane is low.
The HondaJet has two engines over the wings and a T-tail; the Vision Jet has one engine on top of the fuselage and a V-tail.

usCount.source: Honda Aircraft deliveries (250th delivered Feb 2024) with ~75% US-registered per FAA registry (approx.)
